audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer labels this a 'Favoured matchup' at carry threat 5/10 while diff is HARD, the win rate is 40%, and every content paragraph says Volibear takes the lane.
audit.why: A dive bruiser who heals through the Dream Dust burn and has a point-and-click stun is the archetype Lillia loses to; the page's own late paragraph says exactly that.
audit.corrected: Wording changed to losing matchup, carry threat raised to 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lillia Level 1 and 2+ items and 'Skill' at Level 2, Level 6 and first item, contradicting every why on the same rows.
audit.why: whys[0] 'concede and farm from range', whys[1] 'he owns this stage too', whys[4] 'this is his hardest all-in', whys[5] 'he wins the trade', whys[6] 'I can't solo him'. Packet levelChart is Volibear on rows 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 and Skill on 2 and 3 — an exact match to the prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 flipped to Volibear in both layers with matching ratings, as one group. Rows 2 and 3 left as Skill.
sources: content whys[0], whys[1], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: Sky Splitter is described as a stun in three places, and Thundering Smash is described as a knock-up. Both are wrong.
audit.why: Riot text for Sky Splitter: 'summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius' — slow and shield, no stun, 16s, 1200 range. Thundering Smash: 'gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' — a stun delivered by his next attack at 300 range on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, not a knock-up and not a dash. Frenzied Maul is 5s and only heals on the second cast against the same marked target. Stormbringer is a 550-range leap on 160/135/110 that disables your tower.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter restated as slow-plus-shield, Thundering Smash as a run-down stun on his next attack, Frenzied Maul's second-cast heal condition stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'take the fifteen-second invitation' is an invented cooldown, and the packet flagged zero sequencing cues on this page.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 10-12s, Frenzied Maul 5s, Sky Splitter 16s. None is fifteen.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5]; the Frenzied Maul second-cast break replaces the invented line.
